The first part, the chart builder and saved views, opens as a design-partner beta on Wednesday, Dec 9, for five customers: Orbitly, Zest Grocers, and three accounts from the October trial cohort [2]. Phase 1 was due to be feature-complete behind the flag by Dec 4 [4].

Other customers won't get access before general availability, targeted for late January but not committed [2]. Priya asked the team not to promise access to anyone outside the list and said a waitlist would open in January [1]. Pinecrest has asked for beta access during their evaluation, and Sam said he'd check, but I found no confirmation that they're in [3][1].
